description: Call before reviewing code or a draft report with your own model. Takes the core profiles: general, solidity, report. Scans the files for secrets, then returns a SHA-256 manifest, the reviewer instructions, the output format and the request to answer. File contents are not sent back. When the scan blocks, the result lists file, line and kind of each match. A hosted profile is refused with code hosted_profile: run it with run_review. No account needed.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Set true to send files in which the privacy check found email or IP addresses. Secrets are never sent.

context.description: What the researcher states about the finding. Leave out what is unknown.

actors.description: Each attack step and precondition, with the actor behind it.

cloneDepth.description: Whether the search covered the full history or a shallow clone. full: full history, every branch, tag and pull request. shallow: shallow or single-branch clone.

economics.description: Fee per report, duplicate rule, programme age, date first reproduced.

exclusions.description: The out-of-scope list and every trust statement.

impactList.description: The programme's impact list, pasted verbatim.

impactRow.description: The row ticked on the form, verbatim, with its severity.

loss.description: Attacker net after costs, victim loss against a control run, duration, recovery path.

mocks.description: Every mock, fixture, impersonation and harness-set value in the proof.

notes.description: Anything else the reviewer should know.

ownHistory.description: Your earlier reports on this programme with their closure reasons, and any earlier hold, severity or condition note.

prior.description: Where the prior-art search stands. unchecked: not checked. searched: searched, no match found. overlap: overlap found: same root cause, or a prior fix that covers it. distinct: related issue found, root cause differs.

proof.description: What proof exists today. none: none supplied. local: local test or trace supplied. deployment: local proof, matched to the deployed version.

proofLog.description: Command, commit and captured output. Fork or local.

proofRevision.description: Repository, commit or address the proof ran on.

readBack.description: The stored submission as the platform renders it, and the report id.

rules.description: Severity scale with thresholds, downgrade clauses, interaction bounds and the lowest paid tier.

scope.description: The scope line or asset-list entry that covers this code.

target.description: Programme or project, and the asset under review.

version.description: Deployed revision: the commit, tag or address the files come from.

files.description: The text files to review: up to 50 files, 120 KB each, 240 KB and 20,000 lines together. For a report review, put the draft first and the cited source after it.

content.description: The whole file as UTF-8 text.

mode.description: bounty: a finding for a programme. own-code: code you ship. Only profiles whose mode is "either" read this; it defaults to bounty.

profile.description: Review profile id from list_profiles. Defaults to general.

prompt.description: What to look at. Leave empty for the profile default.

name: prepare_review
title: Prepare a review
